title: No Strikes Today

mood.label: Uneasy calm
mood.summary: Uneasy calm: Trump rules out strikes on Iran for the day and regional talks are set, but Sanaa is bombed, eight die in Gaza and a nurse is killed fighting Ebola. Lula wins Brazil, Vucic concedes to students, and Brent still sits near $114.

style.genre: dub — steel drums, clean guitar skank, sub bass, AkaiLinn

lines: No strikes today, the President said,
but Sanaa shook beneath the jets,
A nurse went out to meet the fever,
the northern lights went out in storms,
the oil flows back, the price still hurts.
